summary: MQ-triggered CICS account-inquiry service (VSAM-MQ variant, sibling of CODATE01). Started by an IBM MQ trigger message, it retrieves the triggering queue via CICS RETRIEVE, opens the input, reply and error MQ queues, reads request messages containing a function code and an account key, reads the requested account record from the account file, and puts an account-data reply message on the reply queue. Errors go to an error queue. A message-driven integration service.

paragraphs.name: 1000-CONTROL
paragraphs.pseudocode: Main driver: clear work areas, open the error queue, and use CICS RETRIEVE to obtain the triggering MQ queue name and set the reply queue. Open the input queue, then loop getting request messages until none remain, service each account request and put a reply, and finally close the queues and return.

annotations.note: MQ/CICS-triggered service; queue names and trigger semantics are environment-specific. Flag integration for SME review.

paragraphs.name: 2100-OPEN-ERROR-QUEUE
paragraphs.pseudocode: Open the MQ error queue for failure reporting.
branches: IF MQ reason not OK -> error

paragraphs.name: 2000-OPEN-INPUT-QUEUE
paragraphs.pseudocode: Connect to the queue manager and open the input request queue for reading.
branches: IF MQ reason not OK -> error

paragraphs.name: 3000-GET-MESSAGE
paragraphs.pseudocode: Get the next request message (function code + account key) from the input queue; when empty, set no-more-messages.

paragraphs.name: 4000-PROCESS-REQUEST
paragraphs.pseudocode: Service the request by function code: read the account file for the requested account key and build the account-data reply.

annotations.note: Exact account-inquiry contract only partially derivable; confirm request/reply layout with an SME.

paragraphs.name: 5000-PUT-REPLY
paragraphs.pseudocode: Put the account-data reply message on the reply queue.
branches: IF MQ put not OK -> error

paragraphs.name: 6000-CLOSE-QUEUES
paragraphs.pseudocode: Close the input, reply and error queues and disconnect from the queue manager.

paragraphs.name: 9000-MQ-ERROR
paragraphs.pseudocode: On any MQ/CICS error, capture the failing operation, condition and reason codes and write an error message to the error queue.
